candidates.title: A Simple and Effective Pruning Approach for Large Language Models
candidates.reason: Foundational retraining-free LLM pruning method (Wanda) directly relevant to inference-time model compression; highly connected to repository compression and MoE pruning lineages.

candidates.title: LLM.int8(): 8-bit Matrix Multiplication for Transformers at Scale
candidates.reason: Foundational LLM inference quantization method enabling 8-bit matrix multiplication at 175B scale while preserving full-precision performance; directly relevant to low-bit inference systems.

candidates.title: Generating Long Sequences with Sparse Transformers
candidates.reason: Foundational sparse-attention work reducing attention complexity to O(n sqrt(n)) and providing fast attention kernels; directly connected to many repository sparse-attention and long-context inference papers.
